shellcheck.note: The hosted scans run on ubuntu-24.04, whose image carries shellcheck 0.9.0; actionlint silently skips shell checks when shellcheck is absent, so the local pre-flight refuses without a pinned binary. 0.9.0 has no Apple Silicon build; 0.10.0 is the closest darwin.aarch64 release.

rustfmt.note: The hosted scans and verify jobs install toolchain 1.98.0 (rustfmt 1.9.0-stable 88d9e12ae1). The scan module otherwise picks the newest rustup toolchain under $HOME, which on an agent profile can be an older rustfmt whose formatting differs; the pre-flight pins this binary and exports it as RUSTFMT.

preflight.note: Budget is advisory; publication requires completed local compilation. Runtime tests execute hosted.

rightkit-ffmpeg.reason: ci/asset-gated.json: its tests need FFmpeg and ffprobe development builds the publish workflow does not provision; those tests skip hosted and the crate's own compile, clippy, doc and remaining tests still qualify it.

rightkit-motion.reason: ci/asset-gated.json: the #[ignore]d tests/encode_e2e.rs needs an ffmpeg binary and encoders the publish workflow does not provision; a missing ffmpeg prints SKIP hosted.

dispatch.retryPolicy: No automatic retry for unchanged SHA/unit. Reconcile ambiguous remote effects before any new attempt.
